sources: Search for a Town of Bison web page (2026-11-22): bisonsd.com/.org/.gov, townofbison(sd).com do not resolve; bison.sd.gov redirects to www.sd.gov/bison, which is the State of South Dakota's 'Project BISON' ERP project site (unrelated); perkinscounty.org (Perkins County) says nothing about the town campground; the Town of Bison 2022-2023 audit report (legislativeaudit.sd.gov/reports/City/BisonCity2023-2022.pdf) does not mention a campground

Google Maps (headless, 2026-11-22): searches for 'Bison City Park Campground Bison SD', 'Bison City Park, Bison, SD 57620', 'campground' at 45.5202,-102.4655 return no campground listing in Bison (they resolve to Custer State Park, the Bison City Police Department 309 1st Ave W (605) 244-5677, or the town itself)

https://www.parkadvisor.com/us/south+dakota/bison/70050/Bison+City+Park (aggregator, unclaimed; read 2026-11-22): one review dated May 27, 2023, 4.0 stars: 'Nice park. Has restrooms and showers. Showers you pay for a small fee, takes quarters.'; 'We stayed here 3 years in a row over the 4th of July Holiday and usually for about 7 days.'; 'Water and electric. The dump station is behind the restrooms.'; 'For only $20 a night'; listing: 4 sites, Water, Electric, Fifty Amp

https://allstays.com/Campgrounds-details/36509.htm (aggregator, read 2026-11-22): 'Rogers St and 1st Ave W', 45.520616,-102.465723, '4 sites', 50 amp, '45 ft max RV length', 'tables, grill, water, toilets, showers, dump, pet friendly, playground'; no phone

Esri World_Imagery 45.5202,-102.4655 (hw 200 m), 2026-11-22: pin on the street between two town park blocks (a treed park with playground to the north; a block with small buildings and a round structure to the south) near the airport; individual RV pads could not be made out; no water nearby
summary: No town page, phone, booking or Google Maps listing exists for the campground; the only evidence it operates is aggregator listings and one ParkAdvisor review of May 2023 ($20 a night, water + electric, pay showers, dump behind the restrooms). Nothing written: stored hookups (50 A, water), 4 sites, 45 ft, dump and first-come rest on directories and stay unconfirmed. Presence question flagged for the reviewer. Not waterfront; pin fine.
flags: PRESENCE / INCLUSION (reviewer): no own page anywhere - the Town of Bison has no website (bison.sd.gov is the state's unrelated 'Project BISON' ERP site), Perkins County's site says nothing, and Google Maps has NO listing for the campground (so the p3-562 'Google listing + phone' keep path is not met). The only evidence of operation is directories (AllStays, ParkAdvisor, RV Life with 1 rating, Roadtrippers which 403s) and one dated camper review: ParkAdvisor, May 27, 2023 - 'We stayed here 3 years in a row over the 4th of July Holiday ... Water and electric. The dump station is behind the restrooms. ... For only $20 a night'. That review is 3.5 years old and not on Google. Keep-with-call-first or drop on presence is the reviewer's call; it is a town campground, so no price gate.

PHONE: none found for the campground or the town office. Google shows the Bison City Police Department (605) 244-5677 at 309 1st Ave W and the Bison City Shop (605) 244-5678; 605-244-5624 is the Perkins County Finance Office (county, not town). No phone suggested.

UNCONFIRMED STORED VALUES (derived from directory-based note prose; nothing written): hookups electric 50 / water, sites 4 / max_rig_ft 45 (AllStays '45 ft max'; Roadtrippers' longest reported rig 36 ft per a search snippet), facilities dump (the 2023 review confirms a dump station), booking fcfs always (no source states it). Fees left empty: the only figure is the 2023 camper report of $20 (pre-2024).

NOTE (if kept): suggested 'City of Bison (Perkins County) park at Rogers St & 1st Ave West: four level gravel RV sites with electric and water, coin-op showers, dump station behind the restrooms, playground and shelter. The town posts no rate, rules or phone and no web page names the campground: confirm locally before relying on it. --Claude'
PIN: stored 45.52020,-102.46550 is ~50 m from AllStays' point 45.520616,-102.465723 - fine. WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed (in town, no water).
WEBSITE: stays empty (no town or campground page exists; aggregators are not suggested).
